name: Proreta
line: A private command center for its owner's own messages, email and calendar.
description: Proreta, a private command center for its owner's own messages, email and calendar.
about: Proreta is a private command center that its owner runs at home. It brings the owner's own texts, email and calendar into one place, so nothing that needs an answer slips by.
Email: it reads the owner's own Gmail with Google's read-only access, so it can't send, change or delete mail.
Calendar: it reads the owner's own Google calendars, read-only, and can't add, change or delete events.
Privacy: what it reads is kept on the owner's own devices, and the owner decides what, if anything, an AI assistant may read.
For now it's for one person's own use. It isn't offered to anyone else, and no one else signs in to it.

Later it may be offered as a package with guided instructions, so others can install their own copy at home. It's meant for privacy-minded people, such as those thinking about using local AI on their email.

privacy.intro: This policy covers Proreta, a private command center that reads its owner's own messages, email and calendar. Only its owner signs in to it, with the owner's own accounts.
collects: Email: with the read-only Gmail access that the owner grants at Google's sign-in, it reads the messages in the owner's own Gmail accounts, with their headers and labels.
Calendar: with read-only Google Calendar access granted the same way, it reads the events on the owner's own calendars, such as their times, titles, places and guests.
Texts and contacts: on the owner's own computers, it reads the owner's own text messages and contacts.
It can't send, change or delete mail or calendar events, and it reads nothing else in the Google account.
privacy.uses: Only to help the owner keep up with the owner's own messages, email and calendar, for example by showing them in one place, sorting them and noting what needs an answer.
privacy.shares: It's never sold, used for ads or used to train AI models. What it reads is kept on the owner's own devices. The owner may let an AI assistant read some of it, only to help with the owner's own messages.
privacy.keeps: For as long as the owner keeps it on those devices. Removing Proreta's access in the Google account stops all further reading of email and calendar.
privacy.choices: The owner can remove its access at any time, under [Third-party apps and services](https://myaccount.google.com/connections) in the Google account.

extra.heading: Google user data
paragraphs: Proreta's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
Proreta is a private tool for its owner's own use. It isn't offered, sold or licensed to anyone else, and no one else may sign in to it.

sections.heading: As is
paragraphs: It's provided as is, with no promise that it works or stays available.
